EmbeddingSettingsUpdate.title: EmbeddingSettingsUpdate
EmbeddingSettingsUpdate.description:
Incoming update for embedding settings. Key is set via the LLM endpoint —
there is only one stored BYOK key, shared by both clients.

ExternalTokenResponse.title: ExternalTokenResponse
ExternalTokenResponse.description:
Plaintext token returned once on generation. Never returned by GET.
Store it immediately — it cannot be recovered after this response.

HealthAutoExportPayload.title: HealthAutoExportPayload
HealthAutoExportPayload.description: Validated body for POST /health-metrics/import (Health Auto Export JSON).

HealthSamplesPayload.title: HealthSamplesPayload
HealthSamplesPayload.description: Validated body for POST /health-metrics/samples (iOS HealthKit sync).

LLMSettingsUpdate.title: LLMSettingsUpdate
LLMSettingsUpdate.description:
Incoming update for LLM settings. api_key is plaintext in, never out.

llm_api_key is the single stored BYOK key — it is also used by the embedding
client (see app/services/llm/factory.py resolve_embedding_credentials).

RecentMealResponse.title: RecentMealResponse
RecentMealResponse.description:
A distinct previously-logged meal, offered for one-tap re-logging.

Deduped by ``dish_name``; ``source_photo_id`` is the most-recent instance's
photo, i.e. the concrete meal that ``clone`` will copy.

SettingsResponse.title: SettingsResponse
SettingsResponse.description: Public view of user settings. Never exposes plaintext keys or encrypted bytes.

TreatmentLogResult.title: TreatmentLogResult
TreatmentLogResult.description: Dose log write plus recomputed protocol summary for the same date.
